title: Give your agent tools with MCP (Python)
titleZh: 用 MCP 给你的 Agent 装上工具（Python）
summary: Build a stateless Model Context Protocol tool server in pure Python — JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch, schema validation, error isolation, and the 2026-07-28 input_required round-trip.
summaryZh: 用纯 Python 构建一个无状态的 MCP 工具服务——JSON-RPC 2.0 分发、schema 校验、错误隔离与 2026-07-28 的 input_required 多轮交互。
outcome: A working MCP tool server implementing the stateless 2026-07-28 specification: no initialize handshake, validated tool arguments, isolated handler failures, and the multi-round input_required flow.
outcomeZh: 一个实现无状态 2026-07-28 规范的 MCP 工具服务：无 initialize 握手、参数校验、处理异常隔离、input_required 多轮交互。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Comfort reading JSON; no API key or model account needed
Any coding agent; standard library only
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
能读 JSON；无需 API Key 或模型账号
任一编码 Agent；仅用标准库

lessons.title: What MCP actually is (2026-07-28)
lessons.objective: A stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 surface for tools — no handshake, no sessions, versions in _meta.
lessons.objectiveZh: 一个面向工具的无状态 JSON-RPC 2.0 接口——无握手、无会话、版本放在 _meta 里。

lessons.title: The JSON-RPC dispatch contract
lessons.objective: Valid requests echo their id; invalid ones get -32600; unknown or removed methods get -32601.
lessons.objectiveZh: 合法请求回显 id；非法请求得 -32600；未知或已移除的方法得 -32601。

lessons.title: Validation and error isolation
lessons.objective: Arguments are untrusted input: validate before execution, and never let a handler crash the transport.
lessons.objectiveZh: 参数是不可信输入：先校验再执行，绝不让处理函数打断传输。

lessons.title: The input_required round-trip
lessons.objective: A tool can ask the client a question mid-call — return the requests, finish on the retry carrying answers.
lessons.objectiveZh: 工具可以在调用中途向客户端提问——先返回问题，客户端带答案重试后完成。

lessons.title: Expose one real tool to your agent
lessons.titleZh: 给你的 Agent 暴露一个真实工具
lessons.objective: Wrap one function you actually own behind the validated, isolated boundary you just built.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把你真正拥有的一个函数包进刚建好的「校验 + 隔离」边界。

scenarios.title: Direct tools/list
scenarios.blurb: Listing tools with no prior handshake.

scenarios.title: Argument validation
scenarios.blurb: A tools/call missing its required argument.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一次缺少必填参数的 tools/call。

scenarios.title: The removed initialize
scenarios.blurb: Calling the method the 2026-07-28 specification removed.
scenarios.blurbZh: 调用 2026-07-28 规范已移除的方法。

verification.method: The reviewed mcp-server contract suite: the starter reproduces the listed boundary failures and the solution passes the full suite; wire samples under scenario/requests/ let you probe the protocol by hand.
verification.methodZh: 经过审核的 mcp-server 契约套件：starter 复现列出的边界失败，solution 通过全部测试；scenario/requests/ 下的线路样本让你可以手动探查协议。

level: Comfortable with Python functions and JSON
levelZh: 熟悉 Python 函数与 JSON
